name: Omul
desc: An endemic whitefish and the lake's main commercial fish. It eats zooplankton, algae and some small fish, and spawns in the rivers feeding the lake.
about: The omul, Coregonus migratorius, also known as Baikal omul (Russian: байкальский омуль), is a whitefish species of the salmon family endemic to Lake Baikal in Siberia, Russia.
